Why Choose Portland Sheep?

Hardy, versatile and full of character — Portland sheep are ideally suited to smallholders and rare breed enthusiasts alike.

Hardy & Adaptable

Originating from Portland Bill, these sheep thrive on rough, exposed land and require minimal intervention — ideal for low-input farming.

Excellent Wool

Portland wool is finely textured with a warm, creamy fleece. Highly sought after by hand-spinners and textile artists.

Friendly Community

Join hundreds of breeders across the UK. Access newsletters, free stock listings, show results, husbandry advice and much more.

A Rare Breed Worth Preserving

The Portland is one of Britain's oldest sheep breeds, with a history stretching back over a thousand years on the Isle of Portland in Dorset. Small, hardy and tan-faced, they are a Conservation Grade breed, classified as Vulnerable by the Rare Breeds Survival Trust.

The Portland Sheep Breeders' Group works to promote and protect the breed, maintaining a studbook and supporting a network of dedicated keepers across the UK and beyond.
